caseNameFull: Lim Chan v. Edward White, as Commissioner of Immigration for the Port of San Francisco

opinions.text: October 11, 1920. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied. Mr. Jackson H. Ralston and Mr. George W. Hott for petitioner. Mr. Assistant Attorney General Stewart and Mr. H. S. Ridgely for respondent.
